content.markdown: You can browse your requests, open details, close open requests, and create new ones. You start with two requests: Update team contact (open) and Find monthly report (closed). You can add more as you work in this tab.

qualifications.confidenceReason: README baseline bullets, initialRequests values and app.ts list/detail/close/reset handlers directly describe the workflow.

content.markdown:
Your list is at /requests. Each title is a link to its details at /requests/:id.

1. Go to /requests to see your requests.
2. Select a title to open its details.
3. If the request is open, close it with Close request. Closed requests do not show this action.
4. Use Reset demo data to restore the original two requests.

qualifications.confidenceReason: README baseline bullets, initialRequests values and app.ts list/detail/close/reset handlers directly describe the workflow.

content.markdown:
Create requests at /requests/new. Title is required and Description is optional. Leading and trailing spaces are removed on save.

1. Go to /requests/new.
2. Enter a title in Title. Enter a description in Description if you want.
3. Submit the form.

If the title is blank you see Enter a title. Otherwise your request is saved as open and you go to its details with Request created.

qualifications.confidenceReason: README create bullet and createRequest validation/form handler directly establish required-field behavior.

content.markdown: You can go directly to /requests, /requests/new, or a detail page and refresh. Going to / takes you to /requests. If you open a request that does not exist you see Request not found. Other unknown paths show Not found.
Your requests stay in this browser tab. Refresh keeps them. Closing the tab ends the session. Reset demo data clears the tab and restores the initial two requests.

qualifications.confidenceReason: server.ts routing/redirect/404 branches and app.ts missing-request branch directly prove the navigation behavior.
